records.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Technical material-map conversion, ONE OpenGL tangent-space normal texture. Image1 is the AUTHORITATIVE SCALAR HEIGHT TARGET H(u,v): white high, black deep. Image2 is secondary ALBEDO registration context only. The output MUST encode the actual spatial gradient of Image1 at every pixel, not blue-tinted height, not embossed shading, not albedo brightness. Preserve EXACT1254x1254 dimensions, crop, plaster-chip geometry, fissure/pore coordinates and tile edges. u is image horizontal to the right; image v is vertically down. Compute tangent normal direction N=normalize((-strength*dH/du,+strength*dH/d(image v),1)). Encode red=128+127*N.x, green=128+127*N.y, blue=128+127*N.z. Therefore flat outward face is RGB128,128,255; where height increases to right RED must decrease; where height increases downward GREEN must increase. BOTH red and green must respond to the true local height slopes, including vertical gradients; do not leave green neutral or invent a light source. Convention X+right,Y+up,Z+outward, green-up OpenGL. Thin mineral lime plaster: broad upper intact fields with tiny surface gradients, shallow flaked rims descending into backing, fine existing cracks recessed. Stronger slopes only at existing chip boundaries, quiet field interiors close to neutral-blue. No new geometry, zoom, cracks, blocks, grid or altered boundaries. Recesses point inward using correct slope directions. No physical lighting, grayscale shading, cast shadows, specular, albedo, AO, text, border, vignette or perspective. Opaque seamless square normal only, exactly registered to height.
